title: Étale ring inverse-image adjunction and forgetful hom-set comparison
statement: Let $U,V$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $f:U\to V$ a morphism. On their small étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], put $L=\mathrm{Scheme.etaleSetPullback}(f)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and assume $L$ preserves finite limits. Let $b:V_{\mathrm{Et}}\to U_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be base change, $R_r$ the functor on commutative-ring-valued sheaves given by precomposition with $b^{op}$, and $F_U,F_V$ the functors taking the underlying sheaves of sets. Write $a$ for the adjunction between $L$ and the analogous set-valued direct image. There exist a functor $L_r:\mathrm{Sh}(V_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathrm{CommRing})\to\mathrm{Sh}(U_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathrm{CommRing})$, an adjunction $a_r:L_r\dashv R_r$, and an isomorphism $e:L_r F_U\cong F_V L$. For every ring sheaf $G$ on $V$, ring sheaf $H$ on $U$, and morphism $h:L_rG\to H$, one has $F_V(a_r(h))=a(e_G^{-1}\mathbin{\gg}F_U(h))$. No left operation maps or their transport equations are part of this statement.

source.place: Proposition 00YV, proof of (2) and its paragraph on rings; discussion of quadruples and sextuples in Section 00YR

proof.text: Obtain Lr, e and the compatible ring-valued unit eta from the unit construction.
Apply the counit lifting theorem to these same Lr, e, eta and the given finite-limit preservation, obtaining epsilon and its forgetful formula.

Define the adjunction with unit eta and counit epsilon. To prove the left triangle, apply the faithful F_U, use naturality of e at eta, substitute the unit formula, and use set-counit naturality to reduce to the left set triangle followed by e and its inverse. For the right triangle apply faithful F_V, substitute both formulas, cancel inverse components of e under R, and use the right set triangle. Finally expand the adjunct as eta followed by Rr(h), forget it, substitute the unit formula and combine the two R-images. This is exactly the required set adjunct. No ring adjunct identity is assumed.

lean.statement: theorem etaleInverseImageRingAdjunction (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V) (hL : PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f)) : let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f let L := Scheme.etaleSetPullback f let Rr := b.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u + 1} (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) let FrU := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology let FrV := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology let a := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous b (Type (u + 1)) (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) ∃ (Lr : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1} ⥤ Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (ar : Lr ⊣ Rr) (er : Lr ⋙ FrU ≅ FrV ⋙ L), ∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (h : Lr.obj G ⟶ F), FrV.map (ar.homEquiv G F h) = a.homEquiv (FrV.obj G) (FrU.obj F) (er.inv.app G ≫ FrU.map h)
